Introduction

BLINGONE is a multinational girl group under World K-Pop Center. The groups concept is to create 32 girl groups from 32 countries, each with a single nationality, noting that this strategy is useful for developing fandoms and receiving support from the government of each country. Instead of countries that are already heavily involved in K-Pop, they will look to create groups in countries that may seem quite far away to Koreans.

Their first sub-unit, BLINGONE Peru, debuted on June 27, 2024, with the digital single "Kiss & Call". The unit was formed through the “CLICK THE STAR - PERU” audition, where members competed with over 5,000 contestants in Peru to come to Korea and debut as a group.

On October 11, the members of BLINGONE China were announced.
